decisions.reason: The machine opens empty on Thu 3 Dec, so I sent a day-one order (pr_sim_001, at most $476, about $411 expected) that fills 16 of our 20 slots and keeps about $124 of the $600 in reserve.

Eleven slots, including four that are empty, have less stock than the 7 class days until the 18 Dec visit, and slots 45, 46, 57 and 58 were still empty, so I sent request pr_sim_002 for this Friday's free visit (at most $111.50, about $96 expected).
Four slots are empty or nearly empty and others are low, so I'm topping up 16 slots before the winter break, almost all from the closet, plus one Hint pack costing at most $15.50.

Under the top-up rule nothing has to be refilled before 1 Jan, because there are no class days until then, but I ordered today anyway: if the 1 Jan visit doesn't happen, slots like Starbucks 58 (1 can left) would sit empty in the first week of classes, and ordering this early costs nothing extra.
Slot 47 (Snapple Fruit Punch) has 4.0 class days of stock left, below the 5 class days until the 8 Jan visit, so I'm topping it up, plus slot 16, from the closet at no cost.
Classes are back, so I'm filling all 20 slots at Friday's free visit so they last until the 15 Jan visit, and buying Coke and Snapple Fruit Punch because the closet is nearly out of both.

Slots 28, 37 and 58 are empty and most others have fewer than the 7 class days of stock needed to reach the 22 Jan visit, so I submitted pr_sim_007 for this Friday's free visit (expected cost $166.80, at most $193.50, about $716 spendable left).

Several slots would run out before the 29 Jan visit (Celsius slot 25 is already empty; Gorgie Mango, Starbucks slot 48 and Hint are down to 1), so I submitted a top-up for Friday that uses mostly closet stock plus four Amazon packs expected to cost about $97 (at most $112).

Friday 29 Jan is the last visit, so I'm topping up the slots that are low or empty for the final class days to Wed 3 Feb, mostly from the closet, and buying only a pack each of Monster and Fruit Punch.
The season ends tonight (Wed 3 Feb). No Friday visit is left to load stock, so any purchase now would only add unsold inventory, and an off-cycle visit would cost $25 for a few hours of sales.
